name: University of the Aegean
summary: Its one English-taught bachelor's is a four-year Eastern Mediterranean archaeology, history and culture BA, taught on the island of Rhodes.

ib.text: The BA names the International Baccalaureate as an accepted qualification, with an indicative 70% average or equivalent; last two school years abroad; B2 English (IELTS 6.5).

programmes.name: Eastern Mediterranean Studies. Archaeology, History, Culture
programmes.about: Interdisciplinary study of the cultures of the eastern Mediterranean from prehistory to the Byzantine and medieval periods, through archaeology, history and classical literature, taught in English in Rhodes.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma with an indicative 70% average; last two school years abroad; B2 English (IELTS 6.5 or equivalent); letters of intent and recommendation; interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee reviews your file: certificate, English proof, letter of intent, two recommendation letters, other qualifications, interview. 2027 weightings not yet published.

notes: The programme accepts only foreign citizens, EU or non-EU, who attended their last two years of secondary school abroad, or at a recognised foreign school in Greece if neither they nor their parents are Greek citizens.
It launched in October 2026 as the university's first four-year foreign-language undergraduate programme; the admissions page says applications for the 2026 intake are closed and gives no 2027 dates.
